extensionDescription.message: Finds first- and third-party domains used by visited sites and keeps the results locally on your device.

openHistoryFailed.message: Could not open the all-sites page.

historyEmptyHint.message: Visited sites will appear here after their domains are collected.

emptyStateTitle.message: No data for the current site yet

emptyStateHint.message: Click refresh or reload the open tab.

openWebPageHint.message: Open a regular web page to see data.

clipboardWriteFailed.message: Could not write data to the clipboard.

noDomainsForScope.message: There are no $1 to copy for the current site.

loadCurrentSiteFailed.message: Could not load current site data.

baseDataSavedReload.message: Basic data was saved. Reload the page for a full scan.

clearConfirm.message: Delete all saved sites and domains?

clearHistoryDialogMessage.message: All saved sites and every domain found for them will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

errorCannotDetermineTab.message: Could not determine the current tab.

errorUnsupportedPage.message: This page is not supported by the extension.

errorNoPageDomain.message: Could not find the page domain.

consentRequired.message: Your consent is required before domains can be collected. Open Privacy and collection to continue.

privacyIntroTitle.message: How the extension handles browsing data

privacyIntro.message: Review the details below before enabling automatic domain collection.

dataCollectedBody.message: Hostnames from opened pages, network resource URLs and declared links, plus the last visit time and visit count.

dataNotCollectedBody.message: Page content, full URLs, query strings, cookies, credentials, form values and request bodies are not saved.

dataStorageBody.message: Saved data stays in Chrome storage on this device. The extension has no analytics and sends no data to a server.

consentDisclosureBody.message: To identify own and third-party services, Site Domains Explorer reads the addresses of websites you open and their network requests, extracts only hostnames, and stores those hostnames locally. This browsing activity is not shared, sold or transmitted off your device.

consentCheckboxLabel.message: I understand this disclosure and agree to local domain collection.

collectionEnabledBody.message: You can disable future collection at any time. Existing history remains available until you delete it.

disableCollectionConfirm.message: Disable future domain collection? Saved history will not be deleted.
